plotTitle: The Hidden City of Numillian: The Veil, the Wards, and the Forbidden Vault
mainObjective: Uncover Numillian’s hidden access routes, survive its memory trials and flooding ward systems, and prevent rival factions from seizing or unleashing the forbidden power sealed beneath the city.

plotPoints.title: Arrival at the Veiled Coast Reliquary
plotPoints.description: The party travels to the mist-choked shoreline of the Veiled Coast Reliquary, a weather-worn gateway built into black cliffs above hidden coves. Local guides claim the fog is not natural, but a warded veil concealing Numillian ruins beneath the surf. Fragments of a seal lattice have begun surfacing in tide pools, and signs suggest someone is deliberately drawing intruders toward the old stone corridors below the coast. The party can gain access by negotiating with wary wardkeepers, sneaking in through half-sunk wreck tunnels, or forcing entry past coastal sentries and living wards. Clues recovered here point onward to deeper memory-warded passages that connect the coast to the city’s buried trial districts.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Introduces the Veiled Coast as the module’s opening destination and establishes the broken seal lattice as the first sign that Numillian’s hidden defenses are failing.

sideQuests.title: Follow the Gulls Through the Fog
sideQuests.description: Track unusual gull formations that circle the cliffs and lead to a concealed stair carved into the stone. The birds are drawn to residual ward magic, and following them can reveal a safer route into the dungeon.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides a stealthier entry route and may avoid an early combat encounter.

sideQuests.title: Salvage from the Half-Sunk Wreck
sideQuests.description: Explore a wreck lodged in a cove to recover a tide-stained chart or ward key that identifies the Reliquary’s hidden doors. The wreck is haunted by territorial shore-dwellers or restless drowned dead.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Yields an advantage for navigating the coast’s stone corridors and may reveal a shortcut to later areas.

plotPoints.title: The Corridors of Salted Memory
plotPoints.description: Inside the Veiled Coast, the party enters a network of stone corridors and chambers lined with shell-inlaid inscriptions, flooded thresholds, and memory-echoing wards. The dungeon’s magic tests visitors with visions of Numillian’s final days, forcing the party to distinguish truth from illusion while navigating shifting passages. Here they discover that the coast was once a sealing site for a hidden archive, and that the wards are destabilizing because someone has been feeding them false memories. The party must choose whether to preserve the fragile ward structure, bypass it through force, or repair it using clues from the inscriptions. Success here can reveal the first reliable route from the coast into Numillian’s deeper trial districts.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Deepens the mystery and turns the coast into both an exploration challenge and a lore-based trial. Choices here affect the state of the ward network and the difficulty of the later city-bound investigations.

sideQuests.title: Recover the Echo-Slate
sideQuests.description: Search a submerged chamber for an ancient slate that records the true sequence of the seal’s creation. The slate is guarded by animated stone remnants and memory-warping hazards.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Clarifies the history of the Veiled Coast and weakens illusion-based defenses later.

sideQuests.title: Free the Trapped Maintenance Mage
sideQuests.description: A maintenance mage trapped in a collapsed side hall knows how the corridor wards can be stabilized. The party must decide whether to rescue them, bargain for their knowledge, or leave them behind to save time.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Can provide a practical route through the dungeon or a future ally, but may cost time and resources.

plotPoints.title: The Chamber of the False Tide
plotPoints.description: At the heart of the Veiled Coast lies a chamber where seawater rises and falls in impossible rhythms around a central seal engine. The party discovers that a hidden saboteur has been using the fog-veils and memory wards to mask a ritual that will either open Numillian’s buried passage or collapse it entirely. Social confrontation becomes possible here, as the saboteur’s agents may be persuaded, exposed, or turned against their leader. The party must decide whether to repair the seal, seize control of the engine, or let the chamber fail to expose what lies beneath. The result determines whether the hidden route to Numillian’s interior remains stable or becomes a dangerous breach leading into the city’s trial districts.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Raises the stakes from exploration to direct conflict over the fate of Numillian’s concealed defenses. Player choices determine whether the transition to the city is controlled, disrupted, or catastrophic.

sideQuests.title: Unmask the Fog-Bound Informant
sideQuests.description: A frightened informant among the chamber attendants knows who is orchestrating the sabotage but fears retaliation. The party can protect, interrogate, or deceive them to gain leverage.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Reveals the enemy’s plan and may expose a hidden ally or traitor.

sideQuests.title: Seal the Breach in the Tide Engine
sideQuests.description: A crack in the chamber’s central mechanism is releasing dangerous surges of saltwater and ward energy. Repairing it requires skill challenges under pressure while hostile forces close in.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Reduces hazards in the climax and may prevent reinforcements from arriving.

plotPoints.title: Arrival at the Threshold of the Memory Trials Expanse
plotPoints.description: With the Veiled Coast’s route exposed, the party reaches the edge of Numillian’s buried districts: a haunted stretch of broken stone halls, wind-scoured causeways, and shrine-courts known as the Memory Trials Expanse. A warded archway, half-swallowed by dust and thorn, marks the first stable entrance beyond the coast. Whispering echoes repeat the characters’ own words with slight distortions, hinting that the expanse is not merely cursed but actively testing intruders. Signs of recent passage suggest someone has already entered seeking the heart of the trials, and the area’s shifting illusions begin to separate truth from suggestion.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Introduces the expanse as a sentient trial-ground and establishes the central mystery: the ruins are awakening because someone is manipulating the memory wards.

sideQuests.title: Echoes That Know Your Name
sideQuests.description: Investigate the threshold echoes to learn which memories the expanse is using against the party. Success reveals a safe path through the first warded corridor and grants insight into the nature of the trials; failure draws a hostile memory-echo encounter.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides a mechanical advantage in later illusion and fear-based challenges, and foreshadows that the expanse adapts to the party’s regrets.

sideQuests.title: The Broken Marker Stones
sideQuests.description: Recover or reassemble ancient waystones near the entrance to reveal the original route through the expanse. The stones are guarded by animated rubble and memory-haunted scavengers.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Unlocks a shorter route to the Hall of Memory Trials and reduces the danger of wandering into looping terrain.

plotPoints.title: The Hall of Memory Trials
plotPoints.description: Deeper inside the expanse, the party reaches a vast chamber complex of shattered halls and forgotten shrines where each room reenacts a different moral or personal trial. Illusions force the characters to confront old failures, while real hazards hide inside false recollections. Here they can encounter Arannis Vey, keeper of the trial chambers, and Mirael of the Third Reflection, an illusion-bound examiner, both of whom may be willing to negotiate if the party proves they understand the purpose of the trials. The party must decide whether to endure the chamber’s tests, bargain for passage, or force their way through by destroying the ward anchors.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Shifts the adventure from approach and discovery into active trial-solving, and reveals that the expanse was built to filter minds as much as bodies.

sideQuests.title: The Examiner’s Bargain
sideQuests.description: Convince Mirael or Arannis to grant the party a sealed memory-token in exchange for helping stabilize a failing trial chamber. This may require a mix of social skill checks and a controlled combat or hazard sequence.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Earns a token that can bypass one major illusion barrier later in the adventure.

sideQuests.title: The Chamber of Regret
sideQuests.description: Enter a side chamber that manifests each character’s greatest regret as a tactical obstacle. Defeating the manifestation yields hidden lore about the origin of the trials and a clue to the final seal.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Reveals that the final ward is keyed to acceptance rather than force, changing how the climax can be approached.

plotPoints.title: The Archive Beneath the Whispering Shrines
plotPoints.description: Beyond the trial halls lies a buried archive of stone tablets, sealed alcoves, and memory prisms where the true history of the expanse is recorded in fragments. Archivist Nymora may appear here, offering forbidden knowledge in exchange for protection or a recovered relic. The party learns that the expanse was designed to contain a dangerous memory engine capable of rewriting testimony, identity, and allegiance. A rival force has entered the archive to seize that power, and the ward network is failing under their intrusion. The party must choose whether to preserve the archive, seize its secrets, or destroy the most dangerous records before they can be used.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Raises the stakes by revealing the true purpose of the site and the enemy’s larger goal: weaponizing memory itself.

sideQuests.title: Nymora’s Missing Tablet
sideQuests.description: Recover a stolen tablet from a trapped scribe-vault before rival intruders destroy it. The tablet contains the keyphrase needed to open the final seal chamber.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides the exact means to access the final chamber without triggering the strongest ward defenses.

sideQuests.title: The Archive Firebreak
sideQuests.description: Prevent a cascade of collapsing memory-prisms from igniting the entire archive. This is a timed environmental challenge that can be solved through athletics, arcana, and quick decisions under pressure.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Saves valuable lore and prevents the final battle from occurring under worsening magical instability.

plotPoints.title: The Seal of the Last Recollection
plotPoints.description: At the heart of the Memory Trials Expanse lies a hidden seal chamber where the memory engine is anchored beneath concentric rings of stone and illusion. Here the party confronts the force behind the corruption: a rival agent or cabal emissary trying to overwrite the region’s collective memory and turn the trials into a weapon of obedience. The climax should combine combat with a final choice: destroy the memory engine, claim it, or rebind it to preserve the expanse’s purpose. High Warden Caldorin’s authority, the surviving examiners, and the accumulated evidence from the archive can all influence the outcome. The final encounter should challenge both the party’s resilience and their willingness to let painful truths remain intact. Success here can also reveal the hidden route onward to Numillian’s inner ward and the deeper vault network below the city.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Concludes the Memory Trials arc with a decisive confrontation over memory, identity, and control of Numillian’s hidden legacy.

sideQuests.title: The Final Ward Alignment
sideQuests.description: Before the climax, align the seal lattice by activating ancient memory pylons in the correct sequence. Doing so weakens the enemy’s defenses or strengthens the chamber against collapse, depending on the party’s choices.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Changes the difficulty and shape of the final encounter.

sideQuests.title: Judgment of the Remembered
sideQuests.description: Free trapped echoes of previous trial-winners whose memories have been bound into the seal. Convincing them to aid the party can provide allies, clues, or a nonviolent path to ending the conflict.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Offers a potential diplomatic resolution and reinforces the theme that memory can be preserved without being controlled.

plotPoints.title: Lanterns Over the Inner Ward of Numillian
plotPoints.description: The party arrives in the crowded Inner Ward of Numillian, where merchants, guild factors, and city watch patrols all seem to be watching the same rain-slick streets for different reasons. A string of coded lantern signals has begun flashing from rooftops above the market squares, and those who follow them vanish into alleyways before they can speak. The heroes must navigate local politics, question wary witnesses, and determine whether the signals are a smuggler’s route, a secret watch operation, or something far more dangerous tied to the city’s hidden wards. Evidence from the Memory Trials suggests the lanterns are part of a wider effort to synchronize a breach into the vault network below the city.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Introduces the city-level investigation and establishes the tension between law, commerce, and secrecy in Numillian’s inner district.

sideQuests.title: The Watchman’s Dilemma
sideQuests.description: A junior watch sergeant asks the party to quietly identify who is bribing patrols without causing a public scandal. The players can investigate the patrol routes, tail suspicious couriers, or confront the sergeant's own superior if they suspect an internal cover-up.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Gains the party access to watch records and a lawful ally, or makes the city watch more hostile if handled poorly.

sideQuests.title: Missing from the Market Ledger
sideQuests.description: A guild clerk insists that several names have been erased from the market ledger as if the people never existed. The party can recover the altered books from a counting house, expose the forger, or learn that the missing names match residents last seen near the lantern signals.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Reveals the first concrete link between the disappearances and a deliberate effort to hide movement through the ward.

plotPoints.title: Secrets in the Guildhalls
plotPoints.description: Following the trail from the markets, the party uncovers a struggle among the guildhalls: one faction wants to expose the lantern route, another wants to protect trade at any cost, and a third is secretly funneling people and goods toward a sealed district beneath the Inner Ward. The heroes must attend a tense guild meeting, infiltrate a records chamber, or bargain with a nervous clerk who knows the route's destination. Their findings point to an old ward-key and a hidden entrance beneath an abandoned counting house. Clues from the earlier trial districts make it clear that the conspiracy here is trying to exploit the same ward logic that governs Numillian’s memory and seal systems.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Moves the investigation from street-level rumors to an organized conspiracy, and reveals the hidden access point leading below the ward.

sideQuests.title: The Forged Writ of Passage
sideQuests.description: The party can obtain, steal, or counterfeit a guild writ that allows passage through restricted doors and watch checkpoints. Doing so may require social maneuvering with a guild factor, stealth through a scribe's office, or a brief fight with hired enforcers guarding the paperwork.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides a legitimate or forged means to enter the hidden route without immediate arrest.

sideQuests.title: The Quiet Auction
sideQuests.description: An illegal auction is being held after dark to sell ward keys, blackmail notes, and half-burned maps of the city. The party can bid, bluff, or break in to secure the ward-key needed to reach the sealed entrance.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Yields the key item needed to open the concealed way below the Inner Ward.

plotPoints.title: The Sealed Way Beneath the Ward
plotPoints.description: The hidden entrance leads into an old service passage and a forgotten chamber of Numillian’s ward lattice, where cracked seals, trapped corridors, and unstable enchantments protect something the city once buried. The party must descend through a mix of exploration hazards, magical locks, and guardians awakened by the recent tampering. In the depths, they discover that the lantern signals are being used to synchronize a breach in the warding network, and that someone is preparing to open a route into a forbidden vault beneath the city. The route below connects the Inner Ward’s civic secrets to the older, more dangerous systems buried under the Vaultlands.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Reveals the true scale of the threat and confirms that the conspiracy is aimed at breaching a sealed vault connected to the city’s hidden history.

sideQuests.title: Rescue in the Maintenance Shafts
sideQuests.description: A trapped maintenance mage or lost worker is heard calling from a collapsed side tunnel. The party can divert time and resources to rescue them, earning a witness who can explain the ward system, or ignore them and press on at the cost of leaving someone to the depths.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides critical lore about the ward lattice and may reveal a safer path to the final chamber.

sideQuests.title: The Broken Seal Node
sideQuests.description: One of the seal nodes is flickering and can be repaired, redirected, or shattered. Fixing it stabilizes the descent and weakens the final enemy's control; breaking it may open a faster route but releases dangerous ward backlash.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Changes the difficulty and conditions of the final confrontation by altering the integrity of the ward network.

plotPoints.title: Arrival in the Submerged Ward
plotPoints.description: The party travels to the half-flooded district known as the Submerged Ward, where black canals cut through drowned streets and ward-stones pulse with sickly blue light beneath the water. Orven Tideglass, a wary ferryman, offers passage through the flooded lanes and warns that something has begun answering the ward-stones from below. The players must earn his trust, navigate unstable rooftops and submerged crossings, and decide whether to investigate the strange lights, help terrified residents evacuate, or follow rumors of a hidden access route into the old ward network. The flood appears linked to the same ward systems that now threaten the city’s deeper vaults.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Establishes the Submerged Ward as a critical route into the lower ward network and reveals that the flood is being manipulated, not merely failing.

sideQuests.title: Lost on the Floodline
sideQuests.description: A child or courier has gone missing between flooded alleys. The party can search by boat or rooftop, finding clues left by something that drags victims under the water without leaving ripples.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Reveals that the canals conceal an intelligent predator or controlled construct.

sideQuests.title: The Ferryman's Toll
sideQuests.description: Orven will guide the party deeper only if they recover a stolen charm taken by canal-thieves from a wrecked shrine. The thieves may be bribed, threatened, or ambushed.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Secures local aid and introduces a moral choice: negotiate with desperate survivors or force the issue.

plotPoints.title: The Whispering Canals
plotPoints.description: Investigating the ward reveals that the canal whispers are not superstition: submerged ward-lines are carrying encoded messages, and the blue-lit stones are relaying commands from an unseen source. The party must explore sunken intersections, decipher ward-script, and confront drowned guardians or waterlogged constructs that defend the district’s sealed infrastructure. Socially, they can question frightened residents, bargain with scavengers, or persuade a masked city oracle to interpret the ward-patterns. The evidence points to a hidden maintenance chamber where the flood control lattice is being overridden from within, and where the route into the deeper wardworks likely begins.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Confirms the flood is being weaponized through the ward network and identifies a deeper access point beneath the district.

sideQuests.title: Blue Light Beneath the Tide
sideQuests.description: A cluster of ward-stones flickers in a repeating sequence. If the party restores the correct pattern, they can open a sealed route; if they fail, the stones awaken a defensive surge.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides an alternate route and reveals that the ward network still recognizes authorized command phrases.

sideQuests.title: The Oracle in the Flood
sideQuests.description: A masked oracle offers a cryptic reading in exchange for a favor: recover a drowned tablet from a submerged home or protect her while she communes with the ward-stones.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Yields a prophecy about who is controlling the ward lattice and what price will be paid if it is not stopped.

plotPoints.title: The Wardworks Below
plotPoints.description: The party descends into the hidden Submerged Wardworks, a maintenance complex of flooded tunnels, pressure valves, and broken seal-machines beneath the town. Here they discover that someone has been rerouting the flood to expose or conceal access to a forbidden vault route. Thalan Deepcurrent, a trapped maintenance mage, can explain the system if freed, but his testimony may conflict with that of a rival wardkeeper envoy. The players must choose whether to preserve the failing flood barriers, shut down the wardworks entirely, or overload them to force open the path to the source of the corruption. This decision changes how much of the district survives the final confrontation and how safely the lower routes can be used to reach Numillian’s deepest seals.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Reveals the mechanism behind the flood and gives the party a direct path toward the controlling force behind the ward failure.

sideQuests.title: Free the Trapped Mage
sideQuests.description: Thalan is pinned behind a jammed seal gate while the chamber floods. The party can rescue him quickly, reroute the water, or abandon him to gain time.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Thalan can provide the layout of the final route and identify the magical signature behind the sabotage.

sideQuests.title: The Broken Pump House
sideQuests.description: A secondary pump station can stabilize part of the district if repaired. Doing so requires hazardous exploration, tool work, and possibly parley with scavengers already stripping the machinery for parts.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Determines whether the final battle occurs amid rising floodwaters or in a partially stabilized ward.

plotPoints.title: The Heart of the Drowned Ward
plotPoints.description: At the deepest sealed chamber, the party confronts the entity or conspirator using the ward lattice to drown the district into a living lock. The climax can be a battle against a cabal agent, a corrupted ward engine, or a submerged guardian animated by stolen command-runes. During the encounter, the players may choose to destroy the ward-heart, seize control of it, or redirect its power to save the Submerged Ward at a terrible cost. Their earlier choices determine whether allies arrive, whether the flood is partially contained, and how difficult the final ritual or fight becomes. If they succeed, the ward-stones go dark or stabilize, and the district is saved from being pulled fully beneath the tide. The route below can also serve as the last safe approach to the forbidden vaultlands if the party still needs to confront the source of the citywide breach.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Resolves the mystery of the Submerged Ward and determines the fate of the district, its survivors, and the hidden ward network beneath it.

sideQuests.title: Seal or Sever
sideQuests.description: Before the final confrontation, the party can choose to reinforce the ancient seals or cut them loose, affecting the battlefield and the long-term safety of the ward.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Creates a strategic choice that changes the final encounter's terrain and aftermath.

sideQuests.title: The Last Message in the Water
sideQuests.description: A final whisper from the canals carries a hidden plea from someone trapped inside the ward lattice. Recovering the speaker may reveal the true mastermind or a redeemable reason for the catastrophe.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Offers a nonviolent resolution path or a moral complication before the climax.

plotPoints.title: Arrival at the Forbidden Vaultlands
plotPoints.description: The party reaches a bleak settlement built around sealed stone vaults half-buried in dust and ruin. Green light seeps from ancient seams at night, and the locals insist that anyone who lingers after dusk risks being taken by the vaults themselves. The characters must secure lodging, gather rumors, and decide whether to trust the fearful wardkeepers, the desperate witnesses, or the suspicious city watch presence that keeps the streets unnaturally quiet. By now, evidence from the city, the floodworks, and the memory trials should make clear that the vaultlands are the final threshold before Numillian’s deepest secret.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Introduces the Vaultlands, establishes the eerie rules of the town, and points the party toward the source of the nightly vanishings.

sideQuests.title: Question the Vanishing Witness
sideQuests.description: Track down a fragmented survivor who saw green light and heard screaming beneath the streets before their memory shattered. Helping them recover a key detail may reveal which vault district is active after dark.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides a clue to the most active sealed vault and a safer route into the investigation.

sideQuests.title: The Wardkeeper's Curfew
sideQuests.description: A local wardkeeper asks the party to respect the night seal and escort frightened townsfolk indoors before curfew. Doing so earns trust, but refusing may expose the party to the town's hidden panic and secret watchers.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Influences local trust and determines whether the wardkeepers treat the party as allies or threats.

plotPoints.title: The Sealed Streets Investigation
plotPoints.description: Following clues through narrow streets and warded alleys, the party investigates why every road seems to end at a locked stone door. They discover that several vault seals are failing in a coordinated pattern, and that someone has been feeding power into the old wards from hidden access points beneath the town. This point mixes social pressure, exploration of abandoned civic buildings, and encounters with guardians or cult agents trying to keep the truth buried. The investigation also reveals that the Vaultlands are tied into the same broader ward lattice that connects Numillian’s coast, trial halls, and submerged districts.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Reveals that the disappearances are not random and that the vault network is being manipulated from within the settlement.

sideQuests.title: The Watchman's Contradiction
sideQuests.description: A city watch captain publicly claims the vaults are secure, but a hidden ledger or witness statement suggests otherwise. The party can expose the lie, negotiate for access, or let the watch remain an uneasy ally.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Changes the party's relationship with the town guard and may open or block access to restricted vault sites.

sideQuests.title: The Green Seep
sideQuests.description: A street-level breach leaks strange green radiance from a cracked seam beneath a shuttered building. Investigating the seep can reveal a shortcut into the underworks or unleash vault-guard constructs that have awakened to contain the leak.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Gives the party a hidden route forward and a sample of the ward-energy driving the haunting.

plotPoints.title: Descent into the Vault Network
plotPoints.description: The party gains entry to the lower vault corridors beneath the town, where sealed chambers, old trial niches, and maintenance passages interlock like a prison built over a secret. Here they confront the truth that the vaults are not merely storage chambers: they are part of a living seal lattice designed to contain something ancient and intelligent. The party must navigate traps, negotiate with trapped keepers and archivists, and survive the vault guardians that awaken when the seals are disturbed. The deeper they go, the more it becomes clear that the same hidden power sought through Numillian’s coast, memory trials, and flooded wards has been waiting here all along.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Confirms the vaults are a containment system and reveals the mechanism behind the vanishings, raising the stakes to a full breach scenario.

sideQuests.title: Recover the Lost Key-Sigil
sideQuests.description: A damaged ward-key is needed to open the deepest chamber safely. The party can retrieve it from a collapsed maintenance route, but doing so may require freeing a trapped mage or battling the constructs guarding the route.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides safer access to the final chamber and reduces the danger of the climactic seal confrontation.

sideQuests.title: The Archivist's Hidden Record
sideQuests.description: An archivist offers forbidden records showing that the vaults were built to imprison a faction within the town itself. The party must decide whether to preserve the record, destroy it, or use it to turn the town against its leaders.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Reveals the political truth behind the vault network and creates a choice that affects the ending.

plotPoints.title: The Night of the Green Seal
plotPoints.description: At the deepest vault, the party confronts the force behind the nightly disappearances: a hidden cabal or corrupted seal-warden attempting to break the ancient prison and release what lies beneath the Forbidden Vaultlands. As the seals flare and the town trembles, the characters must choose whether to reinforce the lattice, destroy the vault engine, or redirect the release to a controlled outcome. The climax combines combat against guardians and conspirators, desperate skill checks to stabilize the seal network, and a final social decision about who should inherit the truth of the vaults. The outcome determines whether Numillian’s hidden city remains protected, becomes exposed, or enters a new era shaped by the party’s choices across every district.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Resolves the central mystery, determines the fate of the town, and decides whether the Vaultlands remain a prison, become a ruin, or transform into something new.

sideQuests.title: Choose the Sealbearer
sideQuests.description: A surviving wardkeeper, scholar, or reluctant local leader offers to help anchor the final ritual, but only one can safely bear the burden. The party must choose who to trust, knowing the decision will shape the town's future authority.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Determines which ally gains influence over the Vaultlands after the climax.

sideQuests.title: Bargain with the Thing Below
sideQuests.description: The entity trapped beneath the vaults can be heard speaking through the green seams, offering knowledge, power, or the return of the vanished in exchange for release. The party may attempt a dangerous parley instead of pure destruction.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Creates a major moral choice that can alter the final encounter and the town's long-term fate.

dmNotes: The module is structured as a single escalating investigation: coast entry -> memory trials -> city politics -> submerged wardworks -> forbidden vault climax.
Each region should foreshadow the next by revealing a shared ward lattice, a common sabotage pattern, and the same forbidden power being sought from different angles.

The Memory Trials Expanse should feel like the hinge between exploration and revelation, while the Inner Ward and Submerged Ward function as parallel investigative branches that converge on the Vaultlands.

Use the side quests to reward different play styles: stealth and exploration at the coast, social and lore play in the trials and inner ward, rescue and hazard management in the submerged ward, and moral decision-making in the vaultlands.
